title: Chhath Mahaparva Vidhi
significance: Ancient Vedic Mahaparva dedicated to Sun God Surya and Shashthi Devi for vitality, purity, and family well-being.
sankalpText: ॐ विष्णुर्विष्णुर्विष्णुः अद्यैतस्य ब्रह्मणोऽह्नि द्वितीयपरार्धे श्रीश्वेतवाराहकल्पे वैवस्वतमन्वन्तरे मम सर्वपापक्षयपूर्वकं आरोग्याय श्रीसूर्यनारायण प्रीतये छठपूजनमहं करिष्ये।

samagriList.name: Raw Milk & Gangajal in copper lota

steps.title: Nahay Khay (Purification)
steps.description: Take ritual bath in flowing river, clean cooking area, prepare Satvik bottle gourd sabzi and rice.
steps.mantra: ॐ अपवित्रः पवित्रो वा सर्वावस्थां गतोऽपि वा। यः स्मरेत्पुण्डरीकाक्षं स बाह्याभ्यन्तरः शुचिः॥

steps.title: Kharna (Sweet Offering)
steps.description: Observe day-long nirjala fast. At dusk, offer Rasiya (jaggery kheer) and Roti to Surya & Chhathi Maiya, then accept prasad.
steps.mantra: ॐ सूर्याय नमः। ॐ षष्ठी देव्यै नमः।

steps.title: Sandhya Arghya (Setting Sun)
steps.description: Assemble Daura with Thekua and seasonal fruits at ghat. Stand in waist-deep water to offer milk and water to setting Surya.
steps.mantra: एहि सूर्य सहस्त्रांशो तेजोराशे जगत्पते। अनुकम्पय मां भक्त्या गृहाणार्घ्यं दिवाकर॥

steps.title: Usha Arghya (Rising Sun & Paran)
steps.description: Return to ghat before dawn. Offer morning Arghya to the rising Sun, seek blessings, and break 36-hour fast with ginger and water.
steps.mantra: ॐ नमो भगवते श्रीसूर्याय नमः। आदित्याय विद्महे प्रभाकराय धीमहि तन्नः सूर्यः प्रचोदयात्॥

title: Thai Pongal Harvest Vidhi
significance: Celebrates the sun entering Makara rasi (harvest abundance) with overflow of sweet milk and rice in traditional brass pots.
sankalpText: ॐ तत्सत् अद्य शुभे शोभने मुहूर्ते सूर्य नारायण प्रीत्यर्थं थाई पोंगल नैवेद्य समर्पणं करिष्ये।

steps.title: Kolam Design & Pot Preparation
steps.description: Draw auspicious sunrise Kolam with rice flour in open courtyard. Tie fresh turmeric plant around the neck of the pot.
steps.mantra: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥

steps.title: Milk Boiling (Pongalo Pongal)
steps.description: Pour fresh milk and water into pot facing East. As milk boils and overflows, family chants 'Pongalo Pongal' celebrating prosperity.
steps.mantra: ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं सूर्यदेवाय नमः।

steps.title: Sakkarai Pongal Cooking
steps.description: Add roasted moong dal, freshly harvested rice, melted jaggery, cardamom, and ghee-roasted cashews into the pot.
steps.mantra: अन्नपतेऽन्नस्य नो देह्यनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः। प्रप्रदातारं तारिष ऊर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पदे॥

steps.title: Surya Samarpanam
steps.description: Serve Pongal on banana leaf with sugarcane, betel leaves, and coconuts facing the sun god with camphor aarti.
steps.mantra: ॐ सूर्याय नमः, ॐ मित्राय नमः, ॐ खगाय नमः, ॐ पूष्णे नमः।

title: Durga Puja & Sandhi Puja Vidhi
significance: Invoking Adi Shakti's triumph over Mahishasura during the exact junction of Ashtami and Navami tithi with 108 lotuses and 108 diyas.
sankalpText: ॐ अद्य आश्विनमासे शुक्लपक्षे महाष्टम्यामवभृथस्नाने श्रीजगद्धात्री दुर्गाप्रीत्यर्थं सन्धिपूजां करिष्ये।

steps.title: Chandi Path & Dhyanam
steps.description: Chant the Devi Suktam from Rigveda and recite Durga Saptashati chapters meditating on her ten-armed form.
steps.mantra: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥

steps.title: Lighting of 108 Pradeeps
steps.description: Light 108 earthen lamps representing the dispelling of demonic darkness during Sandhi Kaal.
steps.mantra: ॐ जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी। दुर्गा क्षमा शिवा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमोऽस्तु ते॥

steps.title: 108 Lotus Offering
steps.description: Offer 108 lotus blooms to the lotus feet of Mother Durga while chanting the 108 names of Durga.
steps.mantra: ॐ महादेव्यै च विद्महे दुर्गFetchायै धीमहि तन्नो देवी प्रचोदयात्॥

steps.title: Dhunuchi Dance & Maha Aarti
steps.description: Perform vibrant traditional Dhunuchi aarti to the rhythmic beats of Dhak drums.
steps.mantra: कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम्। सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि॥

title: Maha Shivratri 4-Prahar Rudrabhishek
significance: Observing the cosmic wedding night of Shiva & Parvati through 4-Prahar Abhishekam with milk, curd, honey, and sugarcane juice.
sankalpText: ॐ नमः शिवाय अद्य महाशिवरात्रौ चतुःप्रहर शिवपूजनम् अकालमृत्युहरणं सर्वपापक्षयपूर्वकं करिष्ये।

steps.title: First Prahar (Dugdha Abhishek)
steps.description: Bathe the Shiva Lingam with pure cow milk and chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra.
steps.mantra: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्॥

steps.title: Second Prahar (Dadhi Abhishek)
steps.description: Offer thick curd and chant the Shiva Panchakshara Stotram for peace of mind.
steps.mantra: नागेन्द्रहाराय त्रिलोचनाय भस्माङ्गरागाय महेश्वराय। नित्याय शुद्धाय दिगम्बराय तस्मै नकाराय नमः शिवाय॥

steps.title: Third Prahar (Ghrita & Madhu)
steps.description: Abhishek with melted cow ghee and sweet forest honey for health and vitality.
steps.mantra: ॐ तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात्॥

steps.title: Fourth Prahar & Bilvashtakam
steps.description: Decorate with bhasma, dhatura, and offer 108 Belpatra with Bilvashtakam recitation.
steps.mantra: त्रिदलं त्रिगुणाकारं त्रिनेत्रं च त्रियायुधम्। त्रिजन्मपापसंहारं एकबिल्वं शिवार्पणम्॥

title: Deepavali Maha Lakshmi-Ganesh Puja
significance: Pradosh and Nishita Kaal Diwali invocation of Goddess Mahalakshmi and Lord Ganesha for wealth, auspiciousness, and accounts opening.
sankalpText: ॐ अस्यां दीपावल्यां प्रदोषकाले महालक्ष्मी-गणपति-कुबेर-सरस्वती प्रीतये पूजनमहं करिष्ये।

steps.title: Kalash Sthapana & Shubh Labh
steps.description: Fill copper kalash with Gangajal, place mango leaves, betel nut, and coconut topped with red cloth. Draw Swastik with Roli.
steps.mantra: कलशस्य मुखे विष्णुः कण्ठे रुद्रः समाश्रितः। मूले त्वस्य स्थितो ब्रह्मा मध्ये मातृगणाः स्मृताः॥

steps.title: Ganesh & Navagraha Pujan
steps.description: Invoke Lord Ganesha first with durva grass, yellow flowers, and modak for obstacle-free year.
steps.mantra: गजाननं भूतगणादिसेवितं कपित्थजम्बूफलचारुभक्षणम्। उमासुतं शोकविनाशकारकं नमामि विघ्नेश्वरपादपङ्कजम्॥

steps.title: Maha Lakshmi Shodashopachara
steps.description: Offer 16 devotional offerings including lotus flower, attar, kheel-batasha, and silver coin to Mata Lakshmi.
steps.mantra: ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं त्रिभुवन महालक्ष्म्यै अस्मांक दारिद्र्य नाशय प्रचुर धन देहि क्लीं ह्रीं श्रीं ॐ॥

steps.title: Deep Malika (Lighting of Lamps)
steps.description: Light the main 4-wick ghee diya (Yamadeep) followed by 21 home diyas chanting Lakshmi Aarti.
steps.mantra: शुभं करोति कल्याणमारोग्यं धनसंपदा। शत्रुबुद्धिविनाशाय दीपज्योतिर्नमोऽस्तु ते॥

title: Janmashtami Krishna Janmotsav Vidhi
significance: Midnight Nishita Kaal celebration of Bhagwan Shri Krishna's avatar with Panchamrit snan, swing (Jhula), and Makhan-Mishri bhog.
sankalpText: ॐ अद्य भाद्रपदमासे कृष्णपक्षे अष्टम्यां तिथौ रोहिणी नक्षत्रे निशीथकाले श्रीकृष्ण जन्माष्टमी जन्मोत्सव पूजनं करिष्ये।

steps.title: Avatar Pratiksha & Bhajan
steps.description: Fast till midnight singing Krishna bhajans and chanting Hare Krishna Mahamantra.
steps.mantra: हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे। हरे राम हरे राम राम राम हरे हरे॥

steps.title: Midnight Birth (Nal Chhedan)
steps.description: Cut cucumber stem at exact 12:00 AM representing the divine emergence of Lord Krishna from Mother Devaki.
steps.mantra: नन्द घर आनन्द भयो जय कन्हैया लाल की। हाथी घोड़ा पालकी जय कन्हैया लाल की॥

steps.title: Panchamrit Abhishek & Shringar
steps.description: Bathe Laddu Gopal in conch shell with milk, curd, honey, and gangajal. Dress in yellow pitambar with Mor Pankh.
steps.mantra: कस्तूरीतिलकं ललाटपटले वक्षःस्थले कौस्तुभं नासाग्रे वरमौक्तिकं करतले वेणुं करे कङ्कणम्॥

steps.title: Jhulan & Bhog Arpan
steps.description: Place Gopal in decorated swing, gently rock while offering fresh butter, mishri, and tulsi leaves.
steps.mantra: त्वदीयं वस्तु गोविन्द तुभ्यमेव समर्पये। गृहाण सुमुखो भूत्वा प्रसीद परमेश्वर॥

title: Ganesh Chaturthi Sthapana & Visarjan
significance: 10-day celebration welcoming Bappa into homes on Bhadrapada Shukla Chaturthi with 21 modaks and durva grass.
sankalpText: ॐ अद्य भाद्रपद शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्थ्यां तिथौ श्रीसिद्धिबुद्धिसहित श्रीमहागणपति प्रीत्यर्थं प्राणप्रतिष्ठापनं पूजनं च करिष्ये।

steps.title: Prana Pratishtha (Consecration)
steps.description: Seat Ganesha on a wooden chaurang covered with red silk. Anoint eyes with ghee and chant life-infusing Vedic mantras.
steps.mantra: ॐ अस्य प्राणप्रतिष्ठापन मन्त्रस्य ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश्वरा ऋषयः ऋग्यजुःसामाथर्वाणि छन्दांसि प्राणो देवता॥

steps.title: Durva & Jaswand Samarpan
steps.description: Offer 21 blades of sacred durva grass reciting Ganesha's 21 holy names along with red hibiscus.
steps.mantra: ॐ गणाधिपाय नमः, ॐ उमापुत्राय नमः, ॐ विघ्ननाशनाय नमः, ॐ विनायकाय नमः, ॐ ईशपुत्राय नमः॥

steps.title: Naivedya Arpan (21 Modaks)
steps.description: Offer 21 steaming hot jaggery and coconut modaks topped with pure cow ghee.
steps.mantra: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः ॐ अमृतोपस्तरणमसि स्वाहा। सत्यं त्वर्तेन परिषञ्चामि।

steps.title: Uttarpuja & Visarjan
steps.description: Perform farewell aarti, shift idol slightly forward, and immerse in water chanting 'Ganpati Bappa Morya Pudhchya Varshi Lavkar Ya'.
steps.mantra: यान्तु देवगणाः सर्वे पूजामादाय मामकीम्। इष्टकामसमृद्ध्यर्थं पुनरागमनाय च॥

title: Shri Satyanarayan Vrat Katha & Vidhi
significance: Performed on Purnima, Thursdays, or milestone events to invoke truth, family harmony, and fulfillment of deep wishes.
sankalpText: ॐ अद्य पौर्णमास्यां तिथौ ममाखिल मनोरथ सिद्ध्यर्थं सत्यनारायण पूजनं कथाश्रवणं च करिष्ये।

samagriList.name: Banana Tree Stems for Mandap Pillars
Sawa Sawa Prasadam (Wheat flour roasted with ghee and sugar)

steps.title: Mandap Sthapana & Kalash
steps.description: Construct four-pillared mandap with banana stems. Establish Kalash and draw Navagraha mandala with colored powders.
steps.mantra: ॐ नारायणाय विद्महे वासुदेवाय धीमहि तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात्॥

steps.title: Panchamrit Snan & Shaligram Pujan
steps.description: Bathe the sacred Shaligram or Vishnu idol with Panchamrit and Ganga water, applying yellow sandalwood.
steps.mantra: शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम्॥

steps.title: Shri Satyanarayan Katha (5 Chapters)
steps.description: Gather family to listen to all five sacred chapters illustrating the miraculous power of truth and faith.
steps.mantra: सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्ये धर्मः सदाश्रितः। सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम्॥

steps.title: Maha Aarti & Prasadam Distribution
steps.description: Perform Vishnu Aarti with camphor, distribute wheat panjiri, bananas, and panchamrit to all participants.
steps.mantra: ॐ जय जगदीश हरे, स्वामी जय जगदीश हरे। भक्त जनों के संकट, दास जनों के संकट, क्षण में दूर करे॥
